description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the submission is well-formed for packet assembly; no chain read is performed and no packet is returned. The full signed packet is the paid dispute_packet_packet call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

challenge.description: The captured 402 challenge object exactly as issued for the paid call being packeted. Processed in memory only, never stored.

delivery.description: The delivery artefact AS RECEIVED: {status (integer 100-599), body (string) } or {status, bodyHash (64-hex SHA-256)} - exactly one of body / bodyHash. Buyer-submitted evidence, NOT verified by this service.

paymentResponse.description: The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header value from the paid call (base64 JSON string; a raw JSON string or the decoded object are also accepted). Processed in memory only, never stored.

settlementSignature.description: Optional explicit settlement reference (the settlement transaction signature). When absent, the header's transaction field is the settlement reference.

name: dispute_packet_precheck
